recipes.name: Soybean sprout & kimchi soup (Kongnamul-kimchiguk: 콩나물김치국)
ingredients: 1 package (12 ounces) soybean sprouts, washed and drained
½ medium size onion (about 3 ounces), sliced
10 large dried anchovies, heads and guts removed
1 daepa, large green onion (or 2 regular green onions), sliced
1 tablespoon plus 1 teaspoon fish sauce (or soup soy sauce to your taste)
instructions: Remove from the heat and take out the anchovy strainer.
Serve the soup with rice, kimchi, and additional side dishes.

ingredient_sections.text: 1 package (12 ounces) soybean sprouts, washed and drained
½ medium size onion (about 3 ounces), sliced
10 large dried anchovies, heads and guts removed
1 daepa, large green onion (or 2 regular green onions), sliced
1 tablespoon plus 1 teaspoon fish sauce (or soup soy sauce to your taste)

instruction_sections.text: Place the anchovies in a soup strainer, or wrap them in cheesecloth.
In a pot, combine soybean sprouts, onion, garlic, and kimchi.
Add 7 cups of water and the anchovy strainer to the pot.
Cover and cook over medium-high heat for 25 minutes.
Stir in the green onion and fish sauce. Cover and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Remove from the heat and take out the anchovy strainer.
Serve the soup with rice, kimchi, and additional side dishes. Enjoy your delicious soup!
